meta_desc: Handmade custom cakes in Sidi Bel Abbès since {year}: birthdays, engagements, weddings, new babies and name tiramisu. Order on WhatsApp.

hero.title: The cake with their name on it.
hero.lead: Handmade in Sidi Bel Abbès since {year}, for birthdays, engagements, weddings and new babies.
hero.caption: The greeting and the name you type are written around the cake board.
hero.note: The name goes into your message.

make.title: What we make
make.cakes_text: Characters, numbers, names: we start from your idea or a photo and make it in sugar.
make.tiramisu_text: The name in white-chocolate letters, in a heart, oval or square box.
make.wedding_text: For the proposal, the engagement or the wedding: a cake in your colours, with the words you choose.

creations.title: Already celebrated in Sidi Bel Abbès

steps.title: Order in three messages
steps.s1: Pick a design from the gallery, or send us your idea as a photo.
steps.s2: On WhatsApp, tell us the date, the number of guests and the name to write.
steps.s3: Together we settle the design, the price, and pickup or delivery.
steps.lead_time: Order at least {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before the date.
